hypothesis: Predicting an exact unconditional fuel growth event and qualifying fuel purchases adds threshold information beyond baseline class probabilities.
difference_from_rejected_specialist: No macro-group routing, summed three-group probabilities or arbitrary blend. Two rule-derived binary targets generate temporally out-of-fold signals; downstream correction includes all configured labels and full baseline class probabilities.

target_definitions.purchase: Unconditional probability of at least configured growth_min_purchases future qualifying Fuel baskets.
target_definitions.fuel_growth_event: Unconditional joint probability: qualifying historical Fuel purchase, qualifying future purchase count, future signed fuel spending satisfies exact >=R20 increment and strict >25% growth relative to clipped prior spend. Does not imply winning against other category events.

dependence: Signals are never multiplied as independent events. Joint growth probability is set to zero when known historical Fuel eligibility is false, before and after calibration; this is an exact rule constraint, not an independence assumption.
upstream_features: Accepted 305 past-only features, unchanged label generator.
upstream_capacity: 15 leaves, min child50, 40 fixed boosting rounds, learning_rate .04, two seeds7/23, one thread; no early-stop or calibration on outer outcomes.
downstream: Standardized log baseline17 probabilities plus log known growth threshold and observed fuel eligibility; candidate adds two calibrated rule logits. Multinomial logistic C=.05, max_iter500; matched no-rule logistic control. Original decision multipliers preserved. Both control and candidate set final Fuel-growth probability to zero for known historical Fuel-ineligible customers, then renormalize; all other configured labels still compete.
calibration: For each downstream training origin, Platt C1 uses only OOF outcomes ending by that origin; identity fallback when no earlier OOF outcomes exist. At evaluation it uses all eligible earlier OOF records. No same-row auxiliary outcomes calibrate its own downstream input.
OOF_origins: December2024 through latest eligible monthly origin; for outer T all training outcomes end<=T. Earlier insufficient nested history uses preregistered40 rounds.
December_limitation: No earlier OOF records with a complete outcome window are available for fitting correction before December2024; no dishonest December correction backtest. Calendar/baseline December remains available.
gate: Both June/September improve weighted F1 over better of realized/reproduced baseline and matching logistic control, mean >=.001. Then at least5/6 positive gains versus same controls, mean>=.001 and worst>=-.002.
quantiles: Deferred: binary exact event target suffices for this minimal round; no conditional-quantile search.
